claim: The INSEE Filosofi 2019 200m-grid ('carreaux') dataset includes age-structure variables broken into 9 age brackets, contradicting the assumption that gridded data is income/poverty-only.
stance_target: Hypothesis that 200m carreaux only carry income/poverty/family-structure variables and that age structure is only available at IRIS level
scope_conditions: Filosofi 2019 gridded data, France metropolitaine, Martinique, La Reunion
quoted_support: ind_0_3 Nombre d'individus de 0 a 3 ans / ind_4_5 / ind_6_10 / ind_11_17 / ind_18_24 / ind_25_39 / ind_40_54 / ind_55_64 / ind_65_79 / ind_80p / ind_inc Nombre d'individus dont l'age est inconnu
numbers: ind_18_24 variable flagged as biased due to fiscal attachment of students to parents' household

claim: The 200m carreaux dataset does NOT include CSP (categorie socio-professionnelle/occupation) or education/diploma-level variables at any grid resolution, because these fields are structurally absent from the underlying Filosofi source (a tax-return-derived dataset), not merely suppressed for confidentiality at fine granularity.
stance_target: Hypothesis that CSP and education/diploma variables are unavailable at the 200m carreaux level and only available at coarser IRIS/census level
scope_conditions: Filosofi 2019 gridded data, all three grid resolutions (natural level, 1km, 200m)
quoted_support: La source Filosofi permet en outre de disposer de caracteristiques socio-demographiques ou de caracteristiques au niveau des logements occupes. [Full variable list in section II.2 contains no CSP or diploma field; only income, poverty, household composition, housing, and age variables are enumerated.]

claim: The 200m grid carries household-composition and housing-stock variables beyond income/poverty: single-person households, 5+-person households, homeowner households, single-parent households, collective vs. house dwellings, four construction-date brackets, social housing, and total dwelling surface area.
stance_target: Hypothesis that 200m carreaux carry only income/poverty variables (excluding household composition)
scope_conditions: Filosofi 2019 gridded data, variables common to all three grid levels
quoted_support: men_1ind Nombre de menages d'un seul individu / men_5ind Nombre de menages de 5 individus ou plus / men_prop Nombre de menages proprietaires / men_fmp Nombre de menages monoparentaux / men_coll / men_mais / log_av45 / log_45_70 / log_70_90 / log_ap90 / log_inc / log_soc

claim: 79% of 200m grid cells in metropolitan France (representing 20% of the population) fall below the 11-household confidentiality threshold and are statistically imputed rather than directly observed, flagged via indicator variable i_est_200.
stance_target: Reliability/precision of 200m-grid statistics for fine-grained spatial analysis
quoted_support: En utilisant une grille de carreaux de 200 metres de cote, 79 % des carreaux habites de France metropolitaine comprennent moins de 11 menages fiscaux et doivent faire l'objet d'une imputation. Ils representent 20 % de la population totale.

claim: Imputation for under-threshold 200m cells is performed by grouping adjacent cells (via a nested-grid algorithm from natural-level down to 200m) until each group reaches at least 11 fiscal households, then distributing the group's variable values to member cells in proportion to each cell's population count.
stance_target: Methodology used to fill statistical disclosure gaps in the 200m grid
quoted_support: Une fois les groupes determines, on impute a chaque carreau, et pour toutes les variables de diffusion, la valeur moyenne du groupe ponderee par le nombre d'individus.
numbers: 1% of imputed cells originally had 11+ households

claim: The dataset's poor-household count (men_pauv) and standard-of-living sum (ind_snv) undergo special statistical treatment: men_pauv can be truncated at an 80% poverty rate per 200m cell, and individual income (niveau de vie) is winsorized at department-specific 5th/95th percentile thresholds before being summed per cell.
stance_target: Precision/comparability of income and poverty figures derived from the 200m grid
quoted_support: Dans un departement donne, le niveau de vie d'un individu est rabaisse au 95e centile de la distribution departementale si son niveau de vie est superieur a ce seuil... A la suite de ce traitement, 10 % des individus ont ainsi fait l'objet d'une winsorisation de leur niveau de vie.
numbers: 37% of metropolitan 200m cells contain at least one winsorized individual

claim: INSEE explicitly warns against comparing 200m-grid population/household sums to census (recensement) figures for the same commune, and against using imputed 200m data below the scale of a canton in rural areas, due to conceptual differences between Filosofi (fiscal household) and census (individual-residence) counting.
stance_target: Appropriate use of 200m carreaux data for small-area demographic estimation, relevant to bureau-de-vote-level projection work
scope_conditions: Filosofi 2019 200m grid, rural vs urban use guidance
quoted_support: Il ne faut en aucun cas comparer la somme de la population des carreaux composant une commune a la population de la commune au recensement de la population... En zone rurale... il est recommande de ne pas travailler a un niveau en deca de la taille d'un canton et de lisser les donnees.
